name: Forest
use: The brand's voice. Wordmark, headlines, text on paper, the dark ground of covers and screens.

name: Ridge
use: The mountain tone in the logo. Second surface on Forest, chart series, rules on dark grounds.

name: Sun Gold
use: The sun, and only the sun: the disc, one key figure, one call to action. Never text on paper. Under 3 % of any layout.

name: Paper
use: The default ground for print, slides and web. A warm, uncoated-paper white.

name: White
use: Reversed logo, UI surfaces, photography mounts.

name: Ink
use: Body text in long documents, the darkest ground behind photography and film.

name: Stone
use: Captions, metadata, footnotes, secondary text. Passes AA on Paper and White.

name: Haze
use: Hairlines on Paper, table bands, the second paper tone.

name: Sage
use: Data only: the second chart series and map land. Not a background colour.

name: Gold Text
use: Accessible gold for figures and links on Paper (AA for text). Used where Sun Gold would fail contrast.
